text:
In Mexico, the hotel brands **commonly considered** for branded residences include **Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Rosewood, Aman, Auberge, Montage, Viceroy, Hyatt brands such as Thompson, Park Hyatt, and Kimpton, plus Waldorf Astoria, Hilton, Fairmont, Banyan Tree, SLS, Mondrian, MGallery, and Accor-linked brands like Hyde and Faena**.[1][2][4][5][6][7][9][10][13][16][17]

The strongest recurring names across the Mexico-focused sources are **Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Rosewood, Auberge, Montage, and Hyatt-affiliated brands** such as **Thompson** and **Kimpton**.[1][2][4][5][6][10][15][19][20]

A practical way to think about the market is by brand family:
- **Marriott / Ritz-Carlton / St. Regis**: frequently cited in Mexico luxury-branded projects.[1][2][6][10][20]
- **Four Seasons / Park Hyatt / Thompson / Kimpton / Waldorf Astoria / Conrad / Hilton**: all appear in Mexico branded-residence or hotel-residence developments.[1][3][4][7][8][10][13]
- **Independent luxury brands**: **Rosewood, Aman, Auberge, Montage, Viceroy, Banyan Tree, Chablé, Faena**.[1][4][5][6][10][12][16][19]
- **Lifestyle / design-led brands**: **SLS, Mondrian, MGallery, Hyde, W Hotels, The Standard**.[1][2][9][13][16]

If you want, I can also narrow this to the **most active brands in Los Cabos, Riviera Maya, Punta Mita, or Mexico City**.

message.content:
In Mexico, the hotel brands **commonly considered** for branded residences include **Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Rosewood, Aman, Auberge, Montage, Viceroy, Hyatt brands such as Thompson, Park Hyatt, and Kimpton, plus Waldorf Astoria, Hilton, Fairmont, Banyan Tree, SLS, Mondrian, MGallery, and Accor-linked brands like Hyde and Faena**.[1][2][4][5][6][7][9][10][13][16][17]

The strongest recurring names across the Mexico-focused sources are **Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Rosewood, Auberge, Montage, and Hyatt-affiliated brands** such as **Thompson** and **Kimpton**.[1][2][4][5][6][10][15][19][20]

A practical way to think about the market is by brand family:
- **Marriott / Ritz-Carlton / St. Regis**: frequently cited in Mexico luxury-branded projects.[1][2][6][10][20]
- **Four Seasons / Park Hyatt / Thompson / Kimpton / Waldorf Astoria / Conrad / Hilton**: all appear in Mexico branded-residence or hotel-residence developments.[1][3][4][7][8][10][13]
- **Independent luxury brands**: **Rosewood, Aman, Auberge, Montage, Viceroy, Banyan Tree, Chablé, Faena**.[1][4][5][6][10][12][16][19]
- **Lifestyle / design-led brands**: **SLS, Mondrian, MGallery, Hyde, W Hotels, The Standard**.[1][2][9][13][16]

If you want, I can also narrow this to the **most active brands in Los Cabos, Riviera Maya, Punta Mita, or Mexico City**.
